title: Kelly Marie Wellbeing | Bespoke Workplace Wellbeing Services
description: Kelly Marie Wellbeing. BACP-registered counselling and psychotherapy, workplace wellbeing and mental health training for managers. Online and in person.

descriptions.counselling: Counselling and psychotherapy with Kelly Marie, a BACP-registered psychotherapist. Face to face, at your workplace or online.
descriptions.trainingCoaching: Practical mental health training and coaching for managers, HR and teams, based on clinical practice. On site or remote, bespoke and adapted to your organisation.
descriptions.podcast: The Kelly Marie Podcast: honest conversations about mental health from Kelly Marie Wellbeing. Listen on Spotify or watch on YouTube.
descriptions.meetTheTeam: Meet the team behind Kelly Marie Wellbeing's workplace counselling, mental health training and podcast.
descriptions.contact: Get in touch with Kelly Marie Wellbeing about counselling, mental health training or leaflets. Every enquiry is treated in confidence.
descriptions.shop: Printed mental health leaflets for your workplace, written by a BACP-registered psychotherapist, with your own support contacts. Free UK delivery.
